// External energy source/sink\n};\n\n// Static connectivity information for each element\nstruct ElementStatic {\n    idx_t material_idx;\n    idx_t num_connections;\n    idx_t connected_idx[MAX_CONNECTIONS];     // Indices of connected elements\n    val_t connected_flux[MAX_CONNECTIONS];    // Flux coefficients for each connection\n};\n\n// Dynamic state for each element\nstruct ElementDynamic {\n    val_t current_energy;\n    val_t total_flux;\n};\n\n// World state\nstruct World {\n    std::vector<Material> materials;\n    std::vector<ElementStatic> elements_static;\n    std::vector<ElementDynamic> elements_dynamic;\n    std::vector<ElementDynamic> elements_dynamic_swap;\n};\n\n// Material type IDs\nconstexpr idx_t DEFAULT_MAT_ID = 0;\nconstexpr idx_t INFLOW_MAT_ID = 1;\nconstexpr idx_t OUTFLOW_MAT_ID = 2;\n\n// Build a 2D square grid as an unstructured mesh\n// This represents computation on arbitrarily-shaped geometries\nvoid buildSquare2D(World& world, const int n_elems_root) {\n    const int n_elems = n_elems_root * n_elems_root;\n    \n    // Initialize materials\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.0});    // Default material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.5});    // Inflow material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, -0.5});   // Outflow material\n    \n    // Allocate elements\n    world.elements_static.resize(n_elems);\n    world.elements_dynamic.resize(n_elems);\n    world.elements_dynamic_swap.resize(n_elems);\n    \n    // Initialize all elements with default material and zero energy\n    for (int i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n        world.elements_static[i].material_idx = DEFAULT_MAT_ID;\n        world.elements_static[i].num_connections = 0;\n        world.elements_dynamic[i].current_energy = 0.0;\n        world.elements_dynamic[i].total_flux = 0.0;\n    }\n    \n    // Build connectivity: each element connects to its neighbors in 2D grid\n    for (int x = 0; x < n_elems_root; ++x) {\n        for (int y = 0; y < n_elems_root; ++y) {\n            const int idx = x * n_elems_root + y;\n            ElementStatic& elem = world.elements_static[idx];\n            \n            // Connect to neighbors (up, down, left, right)\n            const int offsets[4][2] = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};\n            \n            for (int n = 0; n < 4; ++n) {\n                const int nx = x + offsets[n][0];\n                const int ny = y + offsets[n][1];\n                \n                // Check if neighbor is within bounds\n                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n_elems_root && ny >= 0 && ny < n_elems_root) {\n                    const int neighbor_idx = nx * n_elems_root + ny;\n                    elem.connected_idx[elem.num_connections] = neighbor_idx;\n                    elem.connected_flux[elem.num_connections] = 1.0;\n                    elem.num_connections++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Set corner elements as inflow/outflow to create interesting dynamics\n    const int last = n_elems_root - 1;\n    world.elements_static[0 * n_elems_root + 0].material_idx = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[0 * n_elems_root + last].material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[last * n_elems_root + 0].material_idx = OUTFLOW_MAT_ID;\n    world.elements_static[last * n_elems_root + last].material_idx = INFLOW_MAT_ID;\n}\n\n// Compute energy flux between two elements\ninline val_t computeFlux(const Material& mat, const ElementDynamic& this_elem,\n                        val_t connection_flux, const ElementDynamic& other_elem) {\n    return (other_elem.current_energy - this_elem.current_energy) * \n           mat.transfer_coeff * connection_flux * 0.25;\n}\n\n// Run simulation for n_iters iterations\nvoid runSimulation(World& world, const int n_iters) {\n    const size_t n_elems = world.elements_static.size();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {\n        // Update all elements\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n            const ElementStatic& elem_static = world.elements_static[i];\n            const ElementDynamic& elem_dyn = world.elements_dynamic[i];\n            const Material& mat = world.materials[elem_static.material_idx];\n            \n            // Start with external flow\n            val_t total_flux = mat.external_flow;\n            \n            // Add flux from all connected elements\n            for (idx_t j = 0; j < elem_static.num_connections; ++j) {\n                const idx_t neighbor_idx = elem_static.connected_idx[j];\n                const ElementDynamic& neighbor_dyn = world.elements_dynamic[neighbor_idx];\n                total_flux += computeFlux(mat, elem_dyn, elem_static.connected_flux[j], neighbor_dyn);\n            }\n            \n            // Update element state\n            ElementDynamic& elem_write = world.elements_dynamic_swap[i];\n            elem_write.current_energy = elem_dyn.current_energy + total_flux;\n            elem_write.total_flux = elem_dyn.total_flux + std::abs(total_flux);\n        }\n        \n        // Swap buffers\n        std::swap(world.elements_dynamic, world.elements_dynamic_swap);\n    }\n}\n\n// Validate simulation results\nbool validateResults(const World& world) {\n    val_t energy_sum = 0.0;\n    val_t flux_sum = 0.0;\n    val_t energy_max = finite\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    if (std::abs(energy_sum) > energy_epsilon) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Energy sum diverged from 0 (expected conservation)\\n\");\n        //    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Grid size (NxN Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int n_elems_root = 512;\n    int n_iters = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n_elems_root = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n_iters = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) leaving\n// the memory untouched lets the parallel init loops below perform the first touch.\n// Every element is explicitly written before it is read.\ntemplate <typename T>\nstruct DefaultInitAllocator {\n    using value_type = T;\n\n    DefaultInitAllocator() noexcept = default;\n    template <typename U>\n    DefaultInitAllocator(const DefaultInitAllocator<U>&) noexcept {}\n\n    T* allocate(size_t n) { return std::allocator<T>{}.allocate(n); Args>\n    void construct(U* p, Args&&... args) { ::new (static_cast<void*>(p)) U(std::forward<Args>(args)...); }\n\n    template <typename U>\n    bool operator==(const DefaultInitAllocator<U>&) unstructured mesh\n// This represents computation on arbitrarily-shaped geometries\nvoid buildSquare2D(World& world, const int n_elems_root) {\n    const int n_elems = n_elems_root * n_elems_root;\n    \n    // Initialize materials\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.0});    // Default material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.5});    // Inflow material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, -0.5});   // Outflow material\n    \n    // Allocate elements\n    world.elements_static.resize(n_elems);\n    world.elements_dynamic.resize(n_elems);\n    world.elements_dynamic_swap.resize(n_elems);\n    \n    // Initialize all elements with default material and zero energy.\n    // Static schedule matches runSimulation so each thread first-touches the pages it will use.\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < n_elems; ++i) {\n        world.elements_static[i] = ElementStatic{};\n        world.elements_static[i].material_idx = DEFAULT_MAT_ID;\n        world.elements_dynamic[i] = ElementDynamic{};\n        world.elements_dynamic_swap[i] = ElementDynamic{};\n    }\n\n    // Build connectivity: each element connects to its neighbors in 2D grid\n    // Each element is written only by its own iteration, so the loop is race-free\n    #pragma omp parallel for collapse(2) schedule(static)\n    for (int x = 0; x < n_elems_root; ++x) {\n        for (int y = 0; y < n_elems_root; ++y) {\n            const int idx = x * n_elems_root + y;\n            ElementStatic& elem = world.elements_static[idx];\n\n            // Connect to neighbors (up, down, left, right)\n            const int offsets[4][2] = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}};\n\n            for (int n = 0; n <  \n    // Initialize materials\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.0});    // Default material\n    world.materials.emplace_back(Material{0.8, 0.5});    // Inflow material\n PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Compute a simple hash of the results for verification\nuint64_t computeHash(const vec<ElementDynamic>& elements) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    // XOR is {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzZaDjiCZ5tdD6wv6NeG","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The benchmark is now OpenMP-parallel and matches the original's output, but on this 256-thread SMT host the default thread count performs erratically. Read the performance caveat below before relying on the default run.\n\n**Changes (only `unstructured/unstructured.cpp` and `unstructured/CMakeLists.txt`; no new files, executable name unchanged):**\n- **Simulation:** one `omp parallel` region spans all iterations, with `omp for` per step. Each thread swaps its own read/write buffer pointers, and the vector swap for odd iteration counts is done once at the end, so the final buffer is the same as before.\n- **Initialization:** `buildSquare2D`'s init and connectivity loops run in parallel. A small `DefaultInitAllocator` skips `resize`'s zero-fill on the calling thread, so each thread first-touches its own pages. This matters on this 2-NUMA-node machine.\n- **`computeHash`:** XOR reduction. The hash is a pure XOR of per-element terms, so the result is bit-identical.\n- **Kept sequential on purpose:** `validateResults` sums and the FNV hash in `print_results`. Parallel floating-point summation reorders additions and would change the printed digits; the FNV hash is inherently serial. Both are outside the timed region or are the validation path.\n- **CMake:** `find_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)` and link `OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX`, with no fallback path. Threads use `proc_bind(spread)` in code. I tested `close` and found `spread` equal or slightly faster.\n\n**Correctness:** I built the original and the new version and diffed stdout across 13 configurations (grid sizes 1 to 512 and 1000 iterations, odd and even iteration counts, zero and negative counts, `-r` and `-v`). All match, including the 17-digit sampled values and hash. The only difference is the program path in the usage text. The build is warning-free with `-Wall -Wextra`.\n\n**Performance (this host: 2×64-core EPYC, 256 logical CPUs, shared with other users):**\n\n| Case | Original | New, 64–128 threads |\n|---|---|---|\n| `-n 2048 -i 20` | ~780 ms | ~36–40 ms (~20×) |\n| `-n 512 -i 100` | ~240–280 ms | ~7–11 ms (~25×) |\n\nScaling flattens around 64–128 threads, which suggests the workload is memory-bandwidth bound.\n\n**The caveat:** the default run uses all 256 logical CPUs, and that is erratic here. With `OMP_PLACES=cores` it holds ~3 ms for `-n 512 -i 100`. With the default places (one per SMT sibling) it ranges from 40 to 440 ms, sometimes worse than serial. Places are read from the environment at startup, so the code can't set them. I tested dynamic scheduling as a workaround and it didn't help. Running with `OMP_PLACES=cores` or `OMP_NUM_THREADS=128` is the recommended setting on this kind of machine. I have not verified whether a dedicated, non-SMT-contended host behaves the same way.\n\nI built in `/tmp` to keep the repo clean. Nothing was committed, since you didn't ask for a commit."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1704,"cache_read_input_tokens":58067,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1704},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"a5fb74e0-61a0-4e3b-83a0-482278859b67","uuid":"09ab7377-475e-4d3b-abd6-be20f278f410","timestamp":"2026-10-13T16:36:33.572Z","request_id":"req_011CfzZaDAjMCsJu36btpr6k"}
